title: Listen state + compressed audio stream

name: rolling_buffer

checks.check: short press in Sleep starts Listen
about 70 MB written to the card

short press in Listen saves a clip

recording kept running during the save and transfer

clip still NOT deleted without confirmation

checks.check: short press in Sleep starts Listen
waits for queued clips before Sleep

voice + latest frame sent to phone
phone gets valid JPEG and the voice

title: Prompt from Sleep

checks.check: frame captured from Sleep (camera on briefly)
back to Sleep after the answer

title: Database-edit approval with the Prompt button
